newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tem Fat Hing Fung says pref div HK$0.149.
newsitem.headline: Tem Fat Hing Fung says pref div HK$0.149.

text.p: HONG KONG, May 27, Reuter - Tem Fat Hing Fung (Holdings) Ltd declared a preference share dividend of HK$0.149 per six percent limited voting convertible cumulative redeemable preference share of HK$1.0 each for the period from December 31, 1996 to June 29, 1997, against HK$0.15 a year earlier.
The amount of the dividend payable per share is calculated at six percent on the notional value of HK$5.0 per preference share for the dividend period over a year of 365 days vs 364 days a year ago.
The dividend is payable on June 27 and books close from June 13 to 16.
Tem Fat Hing Fung is a bullion, jewellery and property company.
